name: Create Tests for Module
description: Creates comprehensive tests for an existing module. Analyzes the module's exports and generates test cases for all public functions and methods.

variables.name: modulePath
variables.description: Path to the module to test (e.g., 'src/tasks.ts')

variables.name: testPath
variables.description: Path where tests should be created (e.g., 'tests' or '__tests__')

variables.name: testFramework
variables.description: Test framework to use (bun, jest, vitest)

tasks.description: Read and understand the module to be tested

prompt.template:
Analyze the module at {{modulePath}} to understand what needs to be tested:

1. Read the module file
2. Identify all exports (functions, classes, constants)
3. For each export, understand:
   - Input parameters and types
   - Return type
   - Side effects (file I/O, state changes)
   - Edge cases to consider
4. Note any dependencies that might need mocking

Create a mental map of all the test cases needed.

tasks.description: Create the test file with proper imports and setup

prompt.template:
Create the test file at {{testPath}}/[module-name].test.ts:

1. Import the test framework ({{testFramework}}):
   - For bun: import { describe, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'bun:test'
   - For jest/vitest: import { describe, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from '{{testFramework}}'

2. Import the module being tested
3. Set up any test fixtures or mocks needed
4. Create describe blocks for each major export

Follow the project's existing test patterns if any exist.

Write test cases for the module. For each function/method:

1. Test the happy path (normal usage)
2. Test edge cases:
   - Empty inputs
   - Invalid inputs
   - Boundary values
3. Test error conditions
4. Test any async behavior

For classes:
1. Test construction
2. Test each public method
3. Test state changes
4. Test interactions between methods

Use beforeEach/afterEach for setup/cleanup when needed.
Use clear, descriptive test names.

tasks.description: Run tests and fix any failures

prompt.template:
Run the tests and ensure they all pass:

1. Run: bun test {{testPath}}/[module-name].test.ts
2. If any tests fail:
   - Analyze the failure
   - Fix the test if the expectation was wrong
   - Fix the module if there's a bug
3. Re-run until all tests pass

All tests must pass before completing.
